description: GY-302 BH1750 on I2C1 (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 0x23): power on, continuous H-resolution mode, prints lux = count / 1.2 every 200 ms on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA), AF open-drain, 100 kHz (the GY-302 brings its own pull-ups). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'BH1750 on I2C1 (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA)
', instruction 0x01 (Power On) to 0x23: not acknowledged -> 'BH1750 not found at 0x23
' and idle; otherwise 0x10 (Continuously H-Resolution Mode, 120 ms typ per measurement) and 'continuous H-resolution mode
'. Every 200 ms (first 200 ms after that line) a 2-byte read prints 'lux=<n>.<d> (count <c>)
' with count = MSB << 8 | LSB and lux = count / 1.2 rounded to 0.1 lx (count 600 -> 'lux=500.0').

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no BH1750 on the bus (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires a GY-302 module instead)

boot.USART1:
BH1750 on I2C1 (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA)
BH1750 not found at 0x23
